title: Chapter 204
text:
The structure of the hall made Han Xiao think of words like 'Hall of Brotherhood' and 'Emperor'. The hall was spacious, and there were rows of chairs on both sides. At the end of the hall was a main seat with a white bear skin hanging on it, and there were guards standing by the wall.

At this time, the hall was filled with Overmera's top management, and they all turned to look at Han Xiao. Dozens of eyes gathered together, and coldness and hostility flashed in their eyes.

Han Xiao suddenly came, and in the eyes of many of the top management, he did not come with good intentions. Most of them did not want to meet the suspected legendary assassin in person. They had heard all kinds of stories about Han Xiao, and they knew that he was unpredictable. They did not know what he would do, but Xiao Jin said that since he was a killer, it was safer to meet him in the open.

There were also guards in the hall, and the guards were ready to shoot at any time. Many superhuman guards were also hiding in the dark, providing some sense of security to the top management of Overmera.

"Black Phantom," Delot snorted from the main seat and waved his hand. "Give him a seat."

A guard moved a chair and put it in the middle of the hall, facing Overmera's people, as if it was a trial. Han Xiaoxin knew that this was Overmera's show of strength. He came to their territory alone, and Overmera did not want to lose.

Han Xiao did not care. He put the huge shoulder bag beside his feet, sat down steadily, and said, "Aren't you going to introduce yourselves?"

Delot said lightly, "Don't pretend, you must have checked our information through the dark net."

Han Xiao glanced at the Overmera's members in the hall and found something interesting. The positions of these top management were very clear. The Home School sat around Delot, while Xiao Jin, Se Qi, and the Northern School sat in their own area. This detail told him that Overmera's internal conflicts were not small.

Also, there were a few strong auras hidden around. Han Xiao estimated that if the negotiations broke down, it would be the scene of three hundred executioners … Of course, it was useless against him.

Han Xiao's attention was mostly on Xiao Jin and his people, secretly sizing them up.

These people were the family of the original owner of this body, and they almost killed the original owner of this body …

Bang!

Suddenly, Delot fiercely slapped the armrest of his chair and shouted, "You attacked our territory in Green Valley Town and killed our people, how do you explain this?!"

The atmosphere suddenly became tense. The few powerful auras were ready to make a move, but the other factions were indifferent. Only the Home Faction was full of hostility.

Han Xiao remembered that he had also killed one of Xiao Jin's adopted sons, but Xiao Jin was expressionless at this time, so he couldn't tell what he was thinking.

"So be it. If you don't like it, then do it." Han Xiao smiled faintly.

Delot couldn't believe that Han Xiao dared to be so arrogant in his territory. He was stunned for a second before his face turned furious and he shouted, "You …"

Before he could finish, Han Xiao suddenly said coldly, "You colluded with the Germinal Organization. Not only me, but the Six Nations will not let you go."

Everyone was stunned.

Colluding with the Germinal Organization, when did this happen?

Delot swallowed his anger and said, "What are you talking about? We have never colluded with the Germinal Organization."

Han Xiao said, "The Germinal Organization put a bounty on Zero, and he was once a family member. How do you explain this?"

Delot finally understood why Black Phantom attacked them for no reason. It was because he mistakenly thought that they were related to the Germinal Organization. At that time, the team that was searching for Xiao Han was passing by Green Valley Town and might have been discovered by Black Phantom.

Delot had heard that Black Phantom and the Germinal Organization were enemies, and he felt that he finally found the crux of the problem. He shook his head and said, "You are wrong. The Zero with the bounty is the son of the second leader, Xiao Jin, Xiao Han …"

Xiao Jin frowned and glanced at Delot with a meaningful look.

Delot continued, "But Xiao Han is no longer related to the Overmera. Furthermore, the Germinal Organization put a bounty on Xiao Han, which means that we are enemies, so it is impossible for us to collude with the Germinal Organization."

It seemed that the Overmera wanted to cut off all ties. Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he slowly tried to sound him out. He pretended to be serious and said, "I believe that with the Germinal Organization's intelligence network, they will definitely find out that Xiao Han is one of your people. You are the biggest clue. Would the Germinal Organization not contact you?"

Delot's face froze, but he forced himself to say, "They have not contacted us."

"You think I will believe that? Will the Six Nations' intelligence agencies believe that? " Han Xiao said calmly, "There are many suspicious points. I can only think that you are helping the Germinal Organization find their wanted criminal. It is even possible that the wanted criminal was purposely sent by you to do things for the Germinal Organization."

Delot frowned. "That is not the case at all. There is more to it."

"I would like to hear the so-called 'more to it'."

Han Xiao was fearless, and this attitude made Delot grit his teeth. For the sake of the big picture, he had to cut off all ties with the Germinal Organization. Now that the war between the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization was about to start, if there was a misunderstanding at this point, the Overmera would fall into a harsh winter.

Although Han Xiao came alone, Delot did not dare to act rashly. With Black Phantom's strength and identity, his visit might have been ordered by the Dark Net. If he killed him, he would become an enemy of the Dark Net, and it would prove that he was colluding with the Germinal Organization.

Most importantly, Black Phantom was unfathomable, and the people at the headquarters did not have the confidence to kill him, so it was not worth the risk.

Therefore, at this moment, Delot could only tolerate Han Xiao's arrogant attitude. He glared at Xiao Jin, thinking that everything was caused by Xiao Jin. He rolled his eyes and said loudly, "Okay, Chief Xiao, tell me the details."

Xiao Jin glanced at Delot, turned his head, and said, "Xiao Hai, tell me."

A handsome young man walked out from behind Xiao Jin, and his face was a little gloomy.

Xiao Hai, Xiao Jin's most outstanding eldest son, was in charge of some of the Xiao Faction's affairs. He was a person with real power, and Xiao Jin had groomed him as his successor.

Xiao Hai said calmly, "More than a year ago, I was escorting a supply convoy and was attacked midway. Xiao Han went missing at that time, and his whereabouts were unknown. I have no idea what happened to him after that."

At this time, a leader of the Northern School said, "Tell us more in detail, our esteemed guest doesn't seem to believe it."

Xiao Hai coldly snorted and said, "The attackers were targeting me. Xiao Han is my younger brother. I made him dress up as me and used him as bait to attract their attention. Only then was I able to successfully escape. After that, I brought new troops back to the battlefield to search, but I couldn't find his whereabouts."

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. "So you asked your younger brother to die for you, was he willing?"

"What do you think?" Xiao Hai was impatient.

Everyone whispered and looked at Xiao Hai with all kinds of meanings.

Delot said, "That's how it is. We can show more evidence. Whether you believe it or not, we have nothing to do with the Germinal Organization."

Han Xiao nodded. He had already gotten the information he wanted — the experience of the original owner and the attitude of the original owner's family.

When the original owner was mentioned, the people of the Xiao Faction were indifferent, as if he was a stranger. Especially Xiao Hai, who did not feel guilty about killing his younger brother, and Xiao Jin did not have any dissatisfaction.

In conclusion, the original owner was an insignificant character that was not loved by anyone. Everyone treated him like air.

"You sure are miserable …" Han Xiao thought to himself.
